messages:
Talia (People Ops): Quick Q  Ben is on post-completion OPT and filed STEM extension. Can payroll and benefits go live on his official start while his EAD is pending? Need to coordinate I-9 and benefits eligibility.

Ben (New Hire): I filed STEM on Apr 2 and have the I-797C receipt. My current OPT EAD expires Apr 30. Start date requested May 6. Will the receipt suffice to activate payroll?

Miguel (Immig Legal): Congrats on filing. Receipt notice (I-797C) extends certain protections for STEM cap-gap if employer filed correctly and you had an unexpired OPT EAD at time of filing. But USCIS receipts alone do not equal an EAD card. For I-9, employer can accept the I-797C + expired EAD + I-20 with STEM recommendation in some cases for reverification; however company must follow DHS/USCIS guidance. I'll check and post the exact doc combo we accept.

Lena (Payroll): Payroll needs a valid work authorization on file to start recurring pay. We can set a tentative payroll start date but cannot actually run payroll without a documented authorization. If Ben provides I-797C receipt + proof of timely STEM filing + current EAD until Apr 30, we can flag as "pending STEM" and pay once EAD extension is approved or when we have HR verification exceptions documented. Any manual off-cycle pay will need manager approval.

I9Bot (bot): I-9 reminder: Section 1 must be completed on or before first day. Section 2 physical document inspection required within 3 business days of start. Remote hires must use authorized agent or approved virtual process. See policy: /people-ops/i9-remote-process.pdf

Talia (People Ops): Actionable plan: 1) Ben to upload I-797C receipt, current EAD scan, and STEM I-20 to Ripley today. 2) People Ops to request temporary "pending STEM" payroll flag from Payroll. 3) Schedule a local I-9 inspection with Lena or authorized agent within 3 days of start. 4) If counsel (Miguel) confirms we can proceed with reverification docs, People Ops will document and notify Payroll. :white_check_mark:

Ben (New Hire): Uploaded I-797C + EAD scan + STEM I-20 to Ripley. How do I schedule the in-person I-9 check?

Talia (People Ops): I'll coordinate with Facilities and an authorized I-9 agent. Reception can host the check. Please be available between May 6-8 for a 15-min slot. If you're remote, we'll arrange an authorized agent near you.

Miguel (Immig Legal): Confirming guidance: For STEM extension timely filed while on valid OPT, employers may rely on Form I-797C receipt + unexpired OPT EAD and I-20 for employment authorization during adjudication only if the candidate previously had valid OPT at filing. Keep a copy of receipt and note case in docket. I'll DM a sample reverification memo template for HR to keep in the file.

Lena (Payroll): Got the uploads. I've created payroll placeholder: START=May 6 (pending docs). Please note benefits enrollment windows still depend on active payroll status; benefits kickoff will be activated once payroll entry is confirmed. If we need to back-pay because authorization arrives late, confirm manager sign-off beforehand.

Talia (People Ops): FYI we have an internal policy doc for STEM cases at /people-ops/immigration/stem-guidance.pdf. I'll attach Miguel's memo to the personnel file and create an Expensify template for any courier fees if Ben needs to send originals to counsel.

ExpensifyBot (bot): Expense template created: "immigration-stem-shipping-1801234567". Upload receipts within 30 days.

Ben (New Hire): Thanks all. One last: if USCIS issues an RFE and approval delayed beyond 90 days, does payroll pause?

Miguel (Immig Legal): If RFE causes loss of authorization window, we must stop wage payments unless a different valid authorization is presented. We'll notify People Ops immediately if RFE arrives. For now your receipt is fine to keep the pending flag.

Talia (People Ops): Closing notes: Ben to bring originals to reception for I-9 by May 7 if local. Miguel will add the receipt to the docket: STEM-BEN-2026. Lena will move payroll from placeholder to active once HR verifies documents. I'll follow up with calendar invites for the I-9 slot. Thanks team. :v:
